    "design": "between",

    "analysis_plan": "Mann-Whitney tests and OLS regressions comparing allocations between frames, split by gender, and Probit models to analyze the frequency of 'selfish' (allocating 0) and 'egalitarian' (allocating half) choices.",

    "other_methods_notes": "The study used a balanced pool of 35 male and 35 female dictators per treatment (total 70 dictators per treatment).
